extractedFacts.adultUnder50Pattern: initial 100 micrograms once daily; adjust by 50 micrograms every 3-4 weeks; final daily dose may be 100-200 micrograms
extractedFacts.olderOrCardiacPattern: age >50 and cardiac disease require lower initial doses and slower titration; cardiac disease may start 25 micrograms daily or 50 micrograms on alternate days
extractedFacts.pediatricPattern: maintenance generally 100-150 micrograms/m2; congenital hypothyroidism initial 10-15 micrograms/kg/day for first 3 months; acquired hypothyroidism initial 12.5-50 micrograms/day
extractedFacts.monitoring: dose adjustment requires clinical and thyroid hormone/TSH monitoring
extractedFacts.formulationConstraint: whole tablets and crushed/dispersed tablets are not recommended under age 5; approved oral solution preferred

indications: chemotherapy/radiotherapy induced nausea and vomiting in adults
prevention of postoperative nausea and vomiting in adults
chemotherapy induced nausea and vomiting age >=6 months
extractedFacts.adultCinvRinvPattern: 8 mg orally 1-2 hours before chemotherapy/radiotherapy then 8 mg every 12 hours for up to 5 days; highly emetogenic chemotherapy has a distinct regimen
extractedFacts.pediatricCinvPattern: BSA-based 5 mg/m2 IV or weight-based 0.15 mg/kg IV strategies with IV single-dose maximum 8 mg and subsequent oral dosing
extractedFacts.adultPonvPattern: 16 mg orally one hour before anaesthesia for prevention; established PONV is treated by IV/IM route
extractedFacts.pediatricPonvPattern: oral PONV use not studied; IV 0.1 mg/kg up to 4 mg is specified
extractedFacts.hepatic: moderate or severe hepatic impairment: total daily dose must not exceed 8 mg

extractedFacts.chfTitration: 3.125 mg twice daily for 2 weeks, then 6.25 mg twice daily, 12.5 mg twice daily, then 25 mg twice daily at intervals of at least 2 weeks as tolerated
extractedFacts.chfMaximum: 25 mg twice daily for severe CHF or mild-moderate CHF <85 kg; 50 mg twice daily may be used in mild-moderate CHF >85 kg
extractedFacts.hypertensionPattern: 12.5 mg once daily for first 2 days then 25 mg once daily; may titrate to maximum 50 mg/day
extractedFacts.anginaPattern: 12.5 mg twice daily for first 2 days then 25 mg twice daily; may titrate to 50 mg twice daily
extractedFacts.renal: no dose adjustment indicated in moderate to severe renal impairment
extractedFacts.pediatric: safety and efficacy under 18 years not established

extractedFacts.generalCeiling: total daily dose 400 mg should not be exceeded except in special circumstances
extractedFacts.acutePainPattern: age >=12: initial 100 mg then 50 or 100 mg every 4-6 hours according to clinical need
extractedFacts.chronicPainPattern: age >=12: initial 50 mg then titrate to pain severity with regular reassessment
extractedFacts.elderlyRenalHepatic: over age 75 and renal/hepatic impairment may require longer dosing intervals
extractedFacts.treatmentGovernance: treatment goals, duration and discontinuation strategy are required because dependence and withdrawal can occur

extractedFacts.indicationScope: secondary cardiovascular/cerebrovascular prevention and acute myocardial infarction
extractedFacts.commonMaintenancePattern: 75-160 mg once daily for several secondary prevention indications
extractedFacts.acuteMiPattern: 150-300 mg loading dose followed by 75-160 mg daily
extractedFacts.maxDailyDose: 300 mg/day unless specifically advised by a doctor
extractedFacts.pediatric: under 16 years only on medical advice when benefit outweighs risk
extractedFacts.duration: long-term treatment with the lowest possible dose
